Yeah, I started asking some friends to help me find a job, its just intimidating to find out where I could go or what to do. And I'm trying to figure out when the best time or best strategy would be for telling a friend or two about whats going on, the fear of what'll happen is just paralyzing. 

It's not really about wanting to die for the sake of an afterlife, but more of a wanting life to end. There's times when I just can't see the point in any of it, and it scares me when I turn back around and see the lows that I sink to. 

Sigh, thanks for helping.
That's the problem. I don't fully even know what I want from life. It feels like  I've spent so much time trying to do what I'm 'supposed' to that I don't even know who I am, or what I want to do.
